channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Four arrested after armed robbery and pursuit in Martin County
item.description: Four people accused in an armed robbery of a teenager were arrested after a pursuit in Martin County, according to deputies.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation transforms Fort Pierce into artistic destination with global artist programs
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation in Fort Pierce preserves the Crain Estate while connecting local and international artists through residency programs and public tours of the historic property.

item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles with knee injury
item.description: Tennis star Serena Williams withdrew from her Wimbledon doubles match with sister Venus on Saturday due to a right knee injury sustained earlier in the week.
